faq.q: How do I rank higher on Google Maps for free?
faq.a: Verify your Google Business Profile, choose the right primary category, complete every field, add photos and collect and reply to reviews. None of it costs money.

faq.q: Can I pay Google to rank higher on Maps?
faq.a: No. Google says you can't pay for a better local ranking. You can buy ads, which are labelled as sponsored.

faq.q: Do reviews help Google Maps ranking?
faq.a: Yes. Google says review count and score are part of prominence, and replying shows you value customers.

faq.q: Should I put keywords in my business name?
faq.a: No. Use your real name. Keyword stuffing breaks Google's guidelines and can lead to suspension.

faq.q: How long does Google Maps SEO take?
faq.a: Profile fixes can help within weeks; reviews and local mentions build over a few months.
